# CXF JAX-RS Application Manager

> Manages the lifecycle of JAX-RS applications in OSGi environments using Apache CXF, with dynamic service discovery, provider management, and built-in JSON/interceptor support.

Key facts:
- Java 17, single-module Maven project (OSGi bundle), built with Maven Wrapper (`./mvnw`)
- Apache CXF 3.5.6 as JAX-RS implementation, OSGi Declarative Services 1.3.0 for component management
- Jackson 2.17.2 for JSON marshalling (optional dependencies), Lombok 1.18.34 for code generation
- Dynamically discovers `javax.ws.rs.core.Application` services via OSGi ServiceTrackers
- Provider assignment via OSGi LDAP filters (global, shared, application-specific)
- License: Apache License 2.0

## Core Package — hu.blackbelt.jaxrs

- [src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/jaxrs/ApplicationManager.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/jaxrs/ApplicationManager.java): Central coordinator that discovers JAX-RS Application services and manages their lifecycle
- [src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/jaxrs/ApplicationStore.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/jaxrs/ApplicationStore.java): Tracks individual application state, resolves required providers before starting
- [src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/jaxrs/SharedProviderStore.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/jaxrs/SharedProviderStore.java): Manages global and shared JAX-RS providers with LDAP filter-based assignment
- [src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/jaxrs/ServerManager.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/jaxrs/ServerManager.java): Interface for server operations (start, stop, update applications)
- [src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/jaxrs/CxfServerManager.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/jaxrs/CxfServerManager.java): CXF-specific ServerManager implementation with bus and endpoint management
- [src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/jaxrs/CxfContext.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/jaxrs/CxfContext.java): DS component for custom CXF Bus configuration and interceptor setup

## Application Package — hu.blackbelt.jaxrs.application

- [src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/jaxrs/application/BasicApplication.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/jaxrs/application/BasicApplication.java): Configuration-driven JAX-RS Application DS component that tracks resources via OSGi filters

## Providers Package — hu.blackbelt.jaxrs.providers

- [src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/jaxrs/providers/JacksonProvider.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/jaxrs/providers/JacksonProvider.java): JAX-RS provider for Jackson JSON marshalling
- [src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/jaxrs/providers/ExtendedObjectMapperProvider.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/jaxrs/providers/ExtendedObjectMapperProvider.java): Pre-configured Jackson ObjectMapper with JSR310, JDK8, and JAXB support
- [src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/jaxrs/providers/ISO8601DateParamHandler.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/jaxrs/providers/ISO8601DateParamHandler.java): JAX-RS parameter converter for ISO 8601 date parsing

## Interceptors Package — hu.blackbelt.jaxrs.interceptors

- [src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/jaxrs/interceptors/ExchangeIdDecorator.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/jaxrs/interceptors/ExchangeIdDecorator.java): CXF IN interceptor that sets MDC exchange ID for request tracing
- [src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/jaxrs/interceptors/ExchangeIdResponseWriter.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/jaxrs/interceptors/ExchangeIdResponseWriter.java): CXF OUT interceptor that writes X-Exchange-Id response header

## Examples

- [examples/echo/Echo.java](examples/echo/Echo.java): Sample JAX-RS resource with OSGi configuration files

## Used by

- [judo-platform](../judo-platform): Model-driven OSGi runtime platform with REST APIs and Karaf deployment
- [judo-services](../judo-services): OSGi runtime services enabling multiple data models in a single Karaf container
- [judo-psm-generator-jaxrs](../../template/judo-psm-generator-jaxrs): Generates JAX-RS interfaces, DTOs, and service implementations from PSM
